<# The affected systems.  Expects `rows` (a list of endpoints).

   Up to `detail_max` systems: one row each, with name, port and note.

   More than that printed as one narrow column running for pages (the Name,
   Port and Note cells are mostly empty), so a long list is set FOUR ACROSS:
   each cell an address, with its port when the finding is on one port.  A
   system the finding reaches by an in-scope NAME, or that carries a note
   (Remediated), keeps a row of its own in the table underneath, because
   that is information a cell has no room for.  The host's display name is
   not printed in the compact form.

   The row line ends with << "" >> on purpose: a line that ends in a block
   tag loses its newline (trim_blocks), which would join the table's rows. #>
<# In a contact's list every system carries the deadline of this finding on
   it, so each keeps a row of its own however many there are (the report's
   four-across form has no room for a date). #>
| System | Name | Port | Due | Deadline |
|:------------------|:------------------------------|:-----------|:-------------|:--------------------|
<% for e in rows %>
| << e.address >> | << e.name or e.hostname or "" >> | << e.port or "" >> | << e.get("due_on") or "" >> | << e.get("deadline") or e.state or "" >> |
<% endfor %>
